tasks.title: Reconstruct Logic Pro-inspired DAW control bar with real icons
tasks.description: Rebuild control bar with actual SVG icons rendered via egui::Painter (icons.rs module), LCD-style musical position/tempo/time-signature/key display, transport group (Stop, Play, Record, Cycle), metronome/count-in controls, right-side view/editor buttons — matching Logic Pro X reference layout.
acceptance_criteria: Uses existing egui framework (no second GUI framework added)
Transport buttons render real SVG icons via egui::Painter (not text labels, emoji, or Unicode)
Layout follows Logic Pro X control bar: navigation | transport | LCD display | metronome/count-in | view controls
LCD display shows bar/beat position, tempo, time signature, key
Interactive hover (hot pink) and active (gold) states implemented
Clean thin divider line (not ugly thick gradient strip)
No footer bar; workspace uses central panel
Build passes (cargo build --release succeeds, zero warnings)
PDF reference inspection not possible (model limitation) — layout based on Logic Pro X interface knowledge
tasks.notes: Control bar rewritten with dedicated module (control_bar.rs) + SVG-to-Painter renderer (icons.rs). Real SVG icons (play, record, loop, snap, tempo) rendered via egui::Painter. LCD display shows position/tempo/time sig/key. Transport buttons are visual-only (no audio engine connected). Stop uses snap.svg as placeholder (no stop SVG exists yet). Build passes clean (no warnings). .exe rebuilt and pushed to VegieBreakDAW. PDFs could not be inspected — model does not support PDF input. Next agent: verify visual output against Logic Pro reference screenshot, add stop.svg, connect transport to audio state.
